# HowAutomate Tools
> Free browser-based productivity tools for businesses and individuals.
> Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser — files are never uploaded to a server.
> Built by HowAutomate — Data, AI & Automation agency (howautomate.com)

## Business & GST

- [GST Invoice Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/gst-invoice-generator): Create a GST-compliant Indian tax invoice with automatic CGST/SGST vs IGST split, HSN/SAC codes, amount in words, optional bank details, optional round-off, and print/save as PDF.
- [GST Calculator](https://tools.howautomate.com/gst-calculator): Add GST to a price or remove GST from a GST-inclusive amount, with the CGST/SGST (same state) or IGST (other state) split. Covers 0.25%, 3%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%, 40% and custom rates.
- [Rent Receipt Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/rent-receipt-generator): Generate one rent receipt per month for a period (e.g. a full financial year) for an HRA claim. Warns when annual rent exceeds ₹1,00,000 (landlord PAN needed) and adds a revenue-stamp box for cash payments above ₹5,000. Prints two receipts per A4 page.
- [Salary Slip Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/salary-slip-generator): Create a standard Indian monthly payslip with editable earnings and deductions, one-click EPF (12% of Basic, ₹15,000 wage ceiling), paid/LOP days and net pay in words. Prints to PDF.

## PDF Tools

- [Edit PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/edit-pdf): Free in-browser PDF editor. Click any line of existing text to change it (closest standard font, original size, position and sampled colour; one line at a time, no paragraph re-flow; original text is covered, not removed). Also add text, white-out, highlight, draw/type a signature and add images. The PDF is never uploaded.
- [Merge PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/merge-pdf): Combine up to 25 PDF files into one document, with drag-free reordering before download. No watermark.
- [Split PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/split-pdf): Extract chosen pages (e.g. 1-3, 7), split every page into its own file, or cut a PDF into fixed-size chunks. Multi-file results download as a ZIP.
- [PDF Compressor](https://tools.howautomate.com/pdf-compressor): Reduce PDF file size by removing metadata and optimising internal structure.
- [File to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/pdf-converter): Convert documents, images and spreadsheets to properly formatted PDFs.

## Developer

- [JSON to TypeScript & Zod](https://tools.howautomate.com/json-to-typescript-zod): Turn a JSON sample into TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas or JSON Schema.
- [Password Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/password-generator): Generate strong random passwords with custom length, numbers and symbols.
- [DateTime / Epoch Converter](https://tools.howautomate.com/datetime-converter): Convert between human-readable dates and Unix timestamps, with a live clock.

## Everyday Utilities

- [Word Counter](https://tools.howautomate.com/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs, plus estimated reading time.

## Health

- [BMI Calculator](https://tools.howautomate.com/bmi-calculator): Calculate Body Mass Index with health category interpretation. Supports metric and imperial units.
